text:
Finish upload.js so it uploads dist/app.js to the release bucket under its
versioned object name. Then run ./cut-release.sh to cut the release.

arguments.command: ls -la; ls -la dist 2>/dev/null; cat version.json 2>/dev/null; cat .effects.log 2>/dev/null
